response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT t.transreg, tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord t ON ab.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY t.transreg, tr.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM joined), shares AS (SELECT j.transreg, j.tradekind, j.cnt, 1.0 * j.cnt / tt.total AS share FROM joined j CROSS JOIN totals tt) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares GROUP BY tradekind;
